'use strict';
// Runs only inside the mount/network sandbox. Never accepts a source DB path.
const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),crypto=require('node:crypto'),{DatabaseSync}=require('node:sqlite'),{once}=require('node:events'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
function fingerprint(file){const db=new DatabaseSync(file,{readOnly:true}),out={};try{for(const table of ['online_rooms','replay']){const h=crypto.createHash('sha256');for(const row of db.prepare('SELECT * FROM '+table+' ORDER BY '+(table==='replay'?'id':'code')).iterate())h.update(JSON.stringify(row)+'\n');out[table]=h.digest('hex');}return out;}finally{db.close();}}
async function historicalComparison(root,oldFactory,newFactory,extension){
 const source=path.join(root,'restored.sqlite'),files=['historical-old.sqlite','historical-new.sqlite'].map(f=>path.join(root,f)),token=crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'),hash=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex'),now=Date.now(),originalNow=Date.now,servers=[];let codes;
 try{
  for(const file of files){fs.copyFileSync(source,file,fs.constants.COPYFILE_EXCL);const db=new DatabaseSync(file);try{const rows=db.prepare('SELECT code,data FROM online_rooms ORDER BY code').all();codes=rows.map(r=>r.code);for(const row of rows){const r=JSON.parse(row.data);assert(/^[A-Z2-9]{6}$/.test(row.code));r.createdAt=now;for(const seat of r.seats)seat.lastSeen=now;if(r.seats[0])r.seats[0].hash=hash;if(r.clock)for(const key of ['deadline','decisionDeadline','auctionEnd'])r.clock[key]=now+3600000;db.prepare('UPDATE online_rooms SET data=?,updated_at=? WHERE code=?').run(JSON.stringify(r),now,row.code);}}finally{db.close();}}
  Date.now=()=>now;for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const s=(i?newFactory:oldFactory)({database:files[i],...(i?{extension}:{})});servers.push(s);s.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(s,'listening');}
  let closed=0;for(const code of codes){const replies=[];for(const s of servers){const response=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+s.address().port+'/api/rooms/'+code,{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+token}});replies.push({status:response.status,data:await response.json()});}assert.equal(replies[0].status,replies[1].status);assert([200,410].includes(replies[0].status));if(replies[0].status===200){assert.deepEqual(replies[0].data.room.game,replies[1].data.room.game);assert.equal(replies[0].data.room.gameRevision,replies[1].data.room.gameRevision);assert.deepEqual(replies[0].data.room.seats.map(s=>({id:s.id,character:s.character,color:s.color})),replies[1].data.room.seats.map(s=>({id:s.id,character:s.character,color:s.color})));}else closed++;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10));}
  return {status:'PASS',rooms:codes.length,closed,syntheticCredentialsAndRefreshedClockMetadata:true,scope:'Historical game/economy JSON compared via real GET handlers on two private copies. Real player tokens not used.'};
 }finally{Date.now=originalNow;for(const s of servers)if(s.listening)await new Promise(r=>s.close(r));}
}
async function probe(root){
 const database=path.join(root,'restored.sqlite'),before=fingerprint(database),result={historicalRowsRetained:false,previousStartup:false,candidateStartup:false,fixtureUpgradeReplay:false,fixtureRollbackReplay:false,integrity:false};let server,base;
 const old=require(path.join(root,'previous/online/server.cjs')).createRoomServer,newServer=require(path.join(root,'candidate/online/server.cjs')).createRoomServer,extension=require(path.join(root,'candidate/telegram/shared/room-extension.cjs')).createExtension({handleRooms:require(path.join(root,'candidate/telegram/shared/dist/engine.cjs')).handleRooms,verifyBatch:async checks=>checks.map(()=>false)});
 const close=async()=>{if(server?.listening)await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));};
 const open=async candidate=>{server=(candidate?newServer:old)({database,...(candidate?{extension}:{})});server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1');await once(server,'listening');base='http://127.0.0.1:'+server.address().port;const response=await fetch(base+'/health');assert.equal(response.status,200);await response.arrayBuffer();};
 async function call(route,body,token,status=200,key=crypto.randomUUID()){const r=await fetch(base+'/api/rooms'+route,{method:body===undefined?'GET':'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Idempotency-Key':key,...(token?{Authorization:'Bearer '+token}:{})},...(body===undefined?{}:{body:JSON.stringify(body)})});const value=await r.json();assert.equal(r.status,status);return value;}
 let stage='PREVIOUS_STARTUP';try{
  await open(false);result.previousStartup=true;await close();assert.deepEqual(fingerprint(database),before);
  stage='CANDIDATE_STARTUP';
  await open(true);result.candidateStartup=true;await close();assert.deepEqual(fingerprint(database),before);result.historicalRowsRetained=true;
  stage='HISTORICAL_GET_COMPARISON';
  result.historicalComparison=await historicalComparison(root,old,newServer,extension);
  // Only synthetic new seats are exercised. Existing room credentials are unknown.
  await open(false);const engine=require(path.join(root,'previous/online/dist/engine.cjs')),characters=engine.CHARACTERS,colors=engine.COLORS;
  const host=await call('',{name:'DIAGNOSTIC FIXTURE HOST',character:characters[0].id,color:colors[0].id,mode:'code',capacity:2},null,201),route='/'+host.room.code,guest=await call(route+'/join',{name:'DIAGNOSTIC FIXTURE GUEST',character:characters[1].id,color:colors[1].id});
  await call(route+'/ready',{ready:true},guest.token);const start=await call(route+'/start',{},host.token),actor=start.room.game.players[start.room.game.current].id===host.seatId?host:guest;
  const key=crypto.randomUUID(),command={method:'roll',args:[],requestId:crypto.randomUUID(),gameRevision:start.room.gameRevision},rolled=await call(route+'/action',command,actor.token,200,key);assert.equal(rolled.room.game.rolls,1);await close();
  stage='FIXTURE_UPGRADE_REPLAY';await open(true);assert.deepEqual(await call(route+'/action',command,actor.token,200,key),rolled);assert.deepEqual((await call(route,undefined,guest.token)).room.game,rolled.room.game);result.fixtureUpgradeReplay=true;
  const method={purchase:'buy',end:'endTurn',event:'confirmCard',roll:'roll'}[rolled.room.game.phase];assert(method);const nextActor=rolled.room.game.players[rolled.room.game.current].id===host.seatId?host:guest;const nextKey=crypto.randomUUID(),next={method,args:[],requestId:crypto.randomUUID(),gameRevision:rolled.room.gameRevision},advanced=await call(route+'/action',next,nextActor.token,200,nextKey);await close();
  stage='FIXTURE_ROLLBACK_REPLAY';await open(false);assert.deepEqual(await call(route+'/action',next,nextActor.token,200,nextKey),advanced);assert.deepEqual((await call(route,undefined,host.token)).room.game,advanced.room.game);result.fixtureRollbackReplay=true;await close();
  const db=new DatabaseSync(database,{readOnly:true});try{assert.equal(db.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check').get().integrity_check,'ok');result.integrity=true;}finally{db.close();}
  return result;
 }catch{throw Object.assign(Error('ISOLATED_COMPATIBILITY_FAILED'),{stage});}finally{await close();}
}
if(require.main===module){Promise.resolve().then(()=>{assert.equal(process.getuid(),65534);assert(!fs.existsSync('/root')&&!fs.existsSync('/var/lib/manager-online')&&!fs.existsSync('/opt/manager-online'));assert(Object.values(require('node:os').networkInterfaces()).flat().every(a=>a.internal));assert(!process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN&&!process.env.COSMETIC_RPC_SECRET);return probe('/audit');}).then(result=>fs.writeFileSync('/audit/compatibility.json',JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',isolationVerified:true,...result,scope:'Actual copied server and candidate startup, historical GET comparison with synthetic credentials/clock metadata on copies, synthetic gameplay/replay. No real player commands or credentials used.'}),{mode:0o600})).catch(error=>{fs.writeFileSync('/audit/compatibility.json',JSON.stringify({status:'FAIL',reason:'ISOLATED_COMPATIBILITY_FAILED',stage:error.stage??'ISOLATION_OR_LOAD_OR_BASE_SCHEMA'}),{mode:0o600});process.exitCode=1;});}
module.exports={probe,fingerprint,historicalComparison};
